The real Sentinel detector, L1 reflex engine with its TTL scheduler, policy and incident-scope checks, Ed25519 approval verifier, forward verification worker logic, and postmortem generator ran on a SQLite incident store. Commands go through a fake systemd/PM2 runner, and journal lines and unit status come from fakes. Agent turns are scripted MCP tool calls through an in-process MCP session (claimer franken-sentry), and wa-bridge's poll, vote, and per-step Ed25519 token minting are reproduced in-process. Timestamps follow a simulated clock starting 2026-11-13T03:17:00Z. Reflex latency figures are in-process Go and SQLite timings measured with the real monotonic clock, not kernel-to-reflex latency on hardware. Chat messages and the approval poll are rebuilt from the stored incident data in wa-bridge's message formats; file paths are shown relative to the postmortem directory, and all text is redacted.
